issue.title: ^prj drawer selectors #notebooks and #albums write into bob-generated catalog sections
issue.description:
Found while researching a `## Projects` host catalog for sub-projects
(research:202611/subproject_h2_sections__cld.md §7.3, A11).

Suggested fix: make the `^prj` drawer eligibility (and the drawer menu and
completion lists) exclude every generated host-catalog heading, ideally derived
from the `host_catalog` RegionSpec list (NOTEBOOKS, ALBUMS, and any future spec),
and refuse explicit selections with the existing teaching codes. While there,
consider collapsing the two near-duplicate `reject_generated_*_selector`
functions into one spec-driven guard.

task_type_fields.impact: Low severity, real confusion. A `^prj` drawer capture aimed at `#notebooks` or `#albums` puts an authored bullet in a bob-owned catalog section. The bullet survives (it is outside the `>` region), but the content lands in the wrong place, and the drawer menu or completion may offer those headings as drawers. Any future generated catalog heading (for example the proposed `## Projects`, see research:202611/subproject_h2_sections__cld.md) inherits the gap unless the never-drawer set is driven by the host-catalog RegionSpec list.
task_type_fields.repro:
1. Make a scratch git vault containing:
   - `area.md` (`type: "[[area]]"`);
   - `proj.md` (`type: "[[project]]"`, `parent: "[[area]]"`) holding
     `- [ ] #task #prj Ship the thing! #hide ^prj`, then `## Notebooks` with a
     `> [!notebooks]` callout listing `[[nb|NB]]`, then `## Tasks`;
   - `nb.md` (`type: "[[notebook]]"`, `parent: "[[proj]]"`).
2. Run `BOB_DIR=<scratch> bob capture "drawer note text @proj+prj#notebooks"`.

Observed (bob on apollo, 2026-11-13): the capture succeeds as
`under [ ] #prj Ship the thing! #hide ^prj · Notebooks` and writes
`- drawer note text` on the line directly after the last `>` line of the
bob-owned `[!notebooks]` callout, inside the generated `## Notebooks` section.

Expected: the selector is refused the way `@proj#notebooks` already is
(`notebooks_section_generated`), or at least the generated section is never a
`^prj` drawer. `#albums` reaches the generated `## Albums` section by the same path.

Root cause (read, not yet patched): `src/native/capture_drawers.rs`
`is_structural_h2_key` lists Tasks, the three status-group titles, Pomodoros,
Events, and Highlights, but not the generated host-catalog headings. The
section-bullet path has explicit guards
(`capture/sections.rs` `reject_generated_notebooks_selector` /
`reject_generated_albums_selector`); the `^prj` drawer path
(`cli-project-drawers`) does not consult them.

issue.creation_reason: A verified capture path writes authored bullets into bob-owned Notebooks/Albums catalog sections; the section-bullet path already refuses this, so the drawer path is an inconsistent gap that any new catalog heading would inherit.

payload.description: That phase added generated-section protection for @host#albums section bullets; this bug is the remaining ^prj drawer path it did not cover
